They will vanish and appear in a random location and attack with a ball of ice before vanishing again. ==={{TMC|-}}=== {{Descriptions TMC}} Ice Wizzrobes appear as an ice variant to the standard green [[Wizzrobe]]s and [[Fire Wizzrobe]]s in {{TMC}}. Like the others, they will teleport to random locations throughout the area in which they appear, shooting their ice attack before vanishing again. ==={{ALBW|-}}=== Ice Wizzrobes appear alongside their [[Fire Wizzrobe]] variants in {{ALBW}}. Like previous incarnations, they will randomly appear around the area and attack with a ball of ice before vanishing again. ==={{TFH|-}}=== Ice Wizzrobes appear alongside dark [[Wizzrobe]]s in {{TFH}}. They are common in the [[Ice Cavern]], but also appear in the [[Sky Temple]]. The ice beams they cast can freeze the [[Link]]s on contact. They float at varying heights; those that float high above the ground can be reached by forming a [[Totem]]. They require at least two [[Sword]] strikes to defeat. As ice-based enemies, they are also weak to fire, and can be defeated by a single fireball either thrown or held with the [[Fire Gloves]]. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Ice Wizzrobe}} Ice Wizzrobes can be found near ruins around the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and [[Hyrule Field]] regions in {{BotW}}. They attack by using their [[Ice Rod]]s to summon blasts of cold air or by summoning frozen monsters such as [[Ice Chuchu]]s and [[Ice Keese]]. They also create blizzards to decrease the area's temperature, making it too cold for [[Link]] without cold-resistant [[Armor]] or [[Elixir]]s.{{Cite|They use their ice rods to create freezing blasts of air or to summon frozen monsters and have been known to cause blizzards to severely decrease the temperature around them.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} Ice Wizzrobes, like their variants, will turn invisible after attacking, leaving ripples in the air with each footstep. Striking one in the head with an [[Arrow]] will stun it and give Link time to attack. Hitting it with a fire-based attack, such as with a [[Fire Arrow]] or a [[Flameblade]], will immediately evaporate it. When defeated, Ice Wizzrobes drop their Ice Rods. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TotK |type= Enemies |category= Wizzrobes |needs= * Detailed information on enemy behavior * Detailed information on the enemy's weaknesses * Information on where the enemy appears }} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Enemy |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Ice Wizzrobe}} {{Stub|TotK}} Ice Wizzrobes are [[Wizzrobe]]s that wield [[Ice]] magic. Similarly to their {{BotW|-}} counterparts, they can create blasts of cold air and conjure [[Ice]] [[Monster]]s, along with generating [[Blizzard]]s that cause a [[Freezing Climate]]. They wield [[Traveler's Sword]]s with [[Sapphire]]s [[Fuse|Fused]] to them. When defeated, Ice Wizzrobes drop their Swords. ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= EoW |type= Enemies |category= Enemies in Echoes of Wisdom |needs= Detailed information on the following: * The Enemy's behavior * The Enemy's weaknesses * Where the Enemy appears * What the Echo cost is for the Enemy }} {{Descriptions EoW}} {{Stub|EoW}} Ice Wizzrobes are [[Wizzrobe]]s who use [[Ice]] magic. They can be found on the higher levels of [[Hebra Mountain]], over a pool of [[Cold Water]]. When in combat, they hover in the air, charge, and release an Ice blade that flies at their target. After firing their Ice attack, they teleport to another nearby location and repeat the process. When summoned as an [[Echo]], they have an Echo cost of five. ==Other Appearances== ==={{CoH|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[File:CoH Ice Wizzrobe Sprite.png|left]] Ice Wizzrobes appear as enemies in {{CoH}} where they move to the beat of the music. Here, they act as medium- to long-range combatants for [[Cadence]], [[Link]], [[Yves]], and [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]], teleporting towards them whenever they are nearby and attempt to cast icy projectiles in their direction. They appear for a total of seven beats between each teleport, taking two beats to fully appear and charging their attack on the third. On the fourth beat, they release their magic, letting it fly in a straight line on every single music beat until it makes contact with something. If any of the heroes or even monsters gets struck by the projectile, their bodies will become frozen within a block of ice for a few beats before breaking out of it, rendering them vulnerable to attack. After casting their spell, they will remain stationary until the seventh beat, raising their crystal orbs to the sky in order to teleport themselves away, fading until they finally disappear on the eighth beat. Once gone, they will remain invisible for five beats, or if the heroes are too far away, won't reappear at all until they return to the Ice Wizzrobe's last known location. Despite their appearance, they can still be attacked while fading in and out of teleportation. There is another, stronger version of the Ice Wizzrobe that only appears in the Wizzroboe boss fight if the boss is in its more powerful form. They also appear in [[Octavo]]'s boss fight. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Ice Wizzrobes appear in almost every single [[Stage]]. They are [[Wizzrobe]]s that use their Ice Rods to freeze enemies. Some attacks are making a laser of [[Ice]], or making a rain of Ice fall, which freezes any characters that hit the Ice falling. Ice Wizzrobes are particularly weak to [[Fire Rod]]s or other [[Fire]] weapons, and their [[Weak-Point Gauge]] will appear after being attacked by Fire weapons. They will drop their Ice Rod if a player has not already gotten it, and will drop three pieces of Ice energy that can be used to replenish the Ice Rod's Ice. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * The Ice Wizzrobe [[Figurine]] in the British English release of {{TMC}} erroneously states that they also appear in Dark Hyrule Castle. It also makes reference to the [[Fire Rod]],{{Cite|Appears in the Palace of Winds & Dark Hyrule Castle. They wield ice magic. They're weak against fire, so hit them with your Fire Rod!|Game Screen|TMC|lang= enBr}} an [[Item]] that exists within the game's code, but goes entirely unused. This reference was removed in the American English version of the game. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:CoH Ice Wizzrobe Sprite 2.png|{{Game Label|{{CoH|-}}}}An Ice Wizzrobe summoned by Wizzroboe with two of the Four Champions defeated ==See Also== {{See Also| * Blizzrobe * Electric Wizzrobe * Fire Wizzrobe * Wizzrobe }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|{{Color EoW|Pink|Ice Wizzrobe}}}}
A mighty caster of ice magic, this creature warps across the sky, freezing enemies with frigid blasts.|Notebook|EoW}} {{Cite|Defeated By: Ice Wizzrobe|Game Over|CoH}} }} {{Categories |Ice-Related Enemies, Powerful Enemies, Wizzrobes |bosses= AoC |enemies= FS, TMC, ALBW, TFH, BotW, TotK, EoW, CoH }}
